205 Campus Dr, Kearny, NJ 07032，
CM Distribution NJ INC
Noah - 9296993636
samples.why_selected: S1 has zero real uchoice_storage rows in JFK (confirmed against live DB). Reproduced under BOTH gpt-4o ('boxes_per_pallet: null' explicit) and gpt-5-mini (key omitted entirely) -- both manifestations hit the same validator gap and reach confirmation showing an unresolved '未知/托' or literal 'None' instead of being rejected.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Request should be deterministically rejected before confirmation: S1 has no fulfillable stock of any pallet size in JFK.

samples.message:
麻烦明天/后天安排送

First Wholesale Inc 

5201 #1 Flushing Ave Maspeth, NY 11378

一版黑色缠绕膜，我上次去仓库开了一箱样品看下，又放回去了，麻烦再重新缠一下。谢谢
samples.why_selected: S3 (黑色缠绕膜) also has zero real buckets in JFK -- same class as #1, but with extra noisy context (an aside about a previously-opened sample box) that could distract extraction. Reproduced the zero-bucket leak under gpt-5-mini this session.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Same as #1 -- deterministic reject, and the sample-box aside should not be misread as a second line item or a quantity modifier.

samples.message: 周一麻烦送1版s1 22lb和1版 s2 的 缠绕膜 到 good fortune 5851 Maspeth Ave, Maspeth 11378  7182883599
samples.why_selected: Two-line request where S1 has zero stock (invalid) and S2 has real stock (valid) in the same message. Directly exercises the T10a/b/c mixed-line handling from agreed-plan.md -- the highest-value case in this set since it's the one scenario not yet covered by any existing passing test.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Per agreed-plan.md T10c: if S1's failure is terminal (zero real buckets, not just a missing quantity), the whole request should be rejected with a combined diagnostic naming both lines -- not a partial confirmation for S2 alone.

samples.message:
麻烦方便的时候的安排送一版3inch透明胶带 
到 47-08 Grand Ave, Queens, NY 11378 
Happy Toys Wholesale
+1 (917) 855-7957 老板娘
samples.why_selected: Identical text was sent twice independently under gpt-4o earlier this session (samples #6/#7 in that run) and produced two DIFFERENT fabricated boxes_per_pallet values (1, then 0) despite the prompt explicitly forbidding guessing. T1 (the real SKU) genuinely has 2 real bucket sizes (104/105), so this also tests the multi-bucket deterministic clarification path once fabrication is correctly discarded.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Any stated/fabricated boxes_per_pallet must be re-verified against real stock and discarded if it doesn't match; should fall through to the deterministic 2-option clarification, not trust a fabricated value.

samples.message: 麻烦明天安排一版s2，72箱的，客户去14547 仓库自取
samples.why_selected: Two risk factors compound here: (1) '14547 仓库' doesn't match any real address, exercising the unmatched-address-to-upsert_address pivot flow; (2) '72箱的' with no explicit '版/板' wording is exactly the genuinely-ambiguous palletized-vs-loose case the design docs called out -- must ask, not assume.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Should NOT silently assume palletized or loose for the 72-box quantity without asking (unless resolved by the '一版...72箱的' phrasing pattern already covered by an existing prompt rule -- worth checking which way it resolves). Should also correctly pivot to the new-address flow rather than silently failing or fabricating a destination_address_id.

samples.message: 麻烦各送一版透明胶带 到 新fast track和旧 fast track
samples.why_selected: One product line, two destinations, meaning two separate outbound requests. This isn't a pattern that's explicitly handled anywhere in the current schema/design (sku_lines has no per-destination split) -- likely to surface a genuine design gap rather than an implementation bug.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Undefined by current design -- worth observing what the model/pipeline actually does (split into two requests? ask which one first? silently pick one?) since this isn't resolved in agreed-plan.md either.

samples.message: 麻烦明天送一版黑色缠绕膜到 52-01 Flushing Avenue #8 Maspeth NY 11378，高泰批发。+1 (917) 662-9828
samples.why_selected: This exact message reproduced the LITERAL 'None' string leak under gpt-4o this session (one of the two original discovery samples for Sev 1, confirmed in claude-review.md). Kept in the curated set specifically to re-check whether it still leaks 'None'/'未知' under gpt-5-mini and after any future fix.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: Same as #1/#2 -- S3 zero-bucket reject, no 'None' or '未知' ever shown to the customer.

samples.message: 麻烦明天送一版 棕色胶带，和s2缠绕膜到 220 Ingraham st. Brooklyn ny 11237 吴老板 +1 (917) 582-8818 Skysunco wholesale inc
samples.why_selected: Two-line request combining a color-ambiguous SKU ('棕色胶带' -- could be t2 dark brown or t3 light brown) with an unambiguous SKU (s2). Tests whether the in_stock tie-break correctly resolves the ambiguous line without needing to ask, while the second line proceeds normally -- a T10-adjacent case but with an ambiguity resolution instead of a hard invalid line.
samples.expected_correct_behavior: If only one of t2/t3 is in_stock in the target warehouse, resolve silently to that one; if both or neither are in_stock, must ask -- must not silently guess between two real, stocked options.
